response.sql:
WITH equipment_humidity AS (
  SELECT e.equipregistry AS equipref,
         AVG(se.humepct) AS avg_humidity
  FROM equipment AS e
  LEFT JOIN scanenvironment AS se
    ON se.equipref = e.equipregistry
  GROUP BY e.equipregistry
),
reference_averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS all_equipment_avg
  FROM equipment_humidity
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT eh.equipref,
         eh.avg_humidity,
         eh.avg_humidity - ra.all_equipment_avg AS excess_over_all_avg
  FROM equipment_humidity AS eh
  CROSS JOIN reference_averages AS ra
  WHERE eh.avg_humidity IS NOT NULL
    AND ra.all_equipment_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND eh.avg_humidity > ra.all_equipment_avg
),
scored AS (
  SELECT equipref,
         avg_humidity,
         excess_over_all_avg,
         avg_humidity - AVG(avg_humidity) OVER () AS difference_from_group_mean
  FROM above_average
)
SELECT equipref,
       avg_humidity,
       excess_over_all_avg,
       difference_from_group_mean
FROM scored
ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST,
         equipref
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The all-equipment average is the unweighted mean of each equipment's non-missing humidity average; equipment with no humidity readings has a missing average and is excluded from that mean.
